Title: Set Up Your Team
Content:
Set Up Your Team

Strong team setup prevents downstream problems in events, attendance, travel, and communication.

YouthSports keeps the workflow fast, but the details matter. Use this guide to avoid rework.

Before you start

  • Confirm you are in the right organization and season.
  • Verify your team assignment and active athletes.
  • Check required feature access for your workflow.

Step-by-step

  1. Open your team in admin routes.
  2. Review current season and active roster context.
  3. Confirm event, attendance, and communication surfaces load correctly.
  4. Run one test flow before publishing to families.

Why this can fail

  • Wrong team selected before edits.
  • Outdated season context.
  • Missing feature entitlement for key pages.

Done right looks like

  • Team context is correct and stable.
  • Core workflows open without blockers.
  • No unexpected role or access errors appear.

When this flow is clean, families get clearer updates, and staff spend less time fixing avoidable issues.
